title: Run bee close natively for a lane feature
action: bee close delegates whenever the feature has a lane record (feature_has_lane_record, close.rs:781-791), so a lane feature never reaches the close driver at all - the router reports unsupported_argument_shape (router.rs:78 scopes close to non-lane features). The comment at close.rs:766-777 names the whole unported debt: best_scribing_stamp_ms (close.rs:272-294) must also fold in the lane record's own last_scribing_run when .bee/lanes/<feature>.json exists, taking the freshest of the jsonl ledger, the state record and the lane record; and a corrupt lane record warns with a relative path instead of throwing. Port both, then delete the delegation guard so close runs natively for lane and non-lane features alike. Every other close door - the tests door, D1 uncaptured behavior_change refusal, capture-deferral escape, cell retirement - stays exactly as it is.

truths: bee close --feature <lane> runs the close driver instead of refusing
a lane record's last_scribing_run counts toward the scribing-debt threshold
a corrupt lane record warns and close still runs
non-lane close behaviour is byte-identical to today
